name: comp-105

frames.best_why: The icon has become a green check inside a focus ring, proving the copied state.

tagline: Flashes a green check after copying, with a Click to copy tooltip.
summary: A compact outlined icon button for copying something already on the page. Hovering shows a tooltip; a click swaps the copy glyph for a green check and briefly blocks further clicks.
appearance: A small square dark button with a soft outline holds a thin copy glyph on a near-black stage. When hovered a grey rounded tooltip reading "Click to copy" floats above it, and a dim caption sits below.
behaviour: Hovering shades the button and opens the tooltip. Clicking shrinks the copy glyph away as a green check fades in and the button goes inert for about a second and a half, then the copy icon returns.
demo_content: The tooltip "Click to copy" and the caption "Copy to clipboard" under the button.
search_phrases: copy button that shows a tick
tiny square button with copy symbol
add copy affordance to any value
use_when: A value or block already on the page needs a compact copy affordance without adding another full input row.
avoid_when: The clipboard write is commented out, and the bare glyph needs a tooltip before people read it as copy.
customise: No props are exposed: tooltip text, aria labels and the intended clipboard value live in the file, and the copy call itself is commented out.
weight_why: One icon button, a tooltip and a short scale swap.

a11y.note: The aria-label switches to Copied and the button disables itself, but the scale swap ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The clipboard write is commented out, so a click only shows the check without copying anything.
polish_why: Neat tooltip and check swap; small and otherwise a stock outlined icon button.
title: Copy To Clipboard Button
